notes:
In-match skins, host mode sync and independent Ready.

- Changing booth: switching skin, pickaxe, backpack, glider, contrail or wrap during a match applies right away (21.x), and the skin stays after a respawn. New commands: `cheat setskin <CID>` and `cheat setcosmetic <pickaxe|backpack|glider|contrail|wrap> <ID>`.
- Playing on someone else's backend: your skin and cosmetics are applied a few seconds after you enter the match.
- Picking a mode in Potassium now changes the mode in the lobby too, for every category (Battle Royale, Zero Build, Unvaulted, VIBIN modes…).
- Fix: restarting the server no longer puts your lobby back on Solo.
- Groups: everyone readies up on their own — the leader no longer waits for members and members no longer wait for the leader. A ready member joins as soon as the server is ready, even if the match already started; readying up early just waits, without an error.
